title: Final presentation authority hardening — persisted identity sovereignty, the absolute VISUAL_READY invariant, structural GLB validity, the legacy-payload rule, and the watchdog's independent dual report
author: Coder 2 (presentation layer)
directive: Operator directive R451-C2.5 (Final Presentation Authority Hardening — deliberately narrow: seven required changes + live verification; no visual product expansion, no new 3D-model benchmark, no UI polish). Acceptance gate: R451-C2.5.
round_question: Can the presentation boundary be reached through a projection (a forged geom.artifact_identity or generation), through a contradiction (visual_complete + CONCEPTUAL/UNKNOWN, lineage-vs-identity, a valid header over malformed structure), or through a legacy payload with a convincing render PASS — and still claim visual readiness?
answer: NO — measured: certification traces to PERSISTED identity documents only; the VISUAL_READY state exists only behind the (visual_complete, ENGINEERING) invariant on BOTH layers; the GLB check proves structure, not just a header; a legacy payload can display only LEGACY_STATE_UNAVAILABLE; and the watchdog reports the observed join state and its typed verdict independently — a presentation-class finding is never a scientific rejection.

req_1_no_frontend_state_inference.what: the pre-C2.1 legacy fallback is REPLACED by the legacy-payload rule: a projection with no typed geometry_state whose geometry/render claims exist only as raw fields (availability / glb route / render status / gate verdict) resolves ONLY to the new explicit NON-CURRENT state LEGACY_STATE_UNAVAILABLE (the presentation vocabulary closes at eight). The branch reads NO payload field — its existence IS the legacy fact — so the four forbidden states (VISUAL_READY / GEOMETRY_READY_RENDER_BLOCKED / TECHNOLOGY_NOT_ESTABLISHED / SCIENTIFIC_REJECTION) are structurally unreachable from a legacy payload. The C2-era frontend GATE_PASS_VERDICTS set is DELETED (Art. LXIV): the browser no longer reads gate verdicts at all. TechStage renders the legacy state as its own hero (no model, no viewer from legacy fields) with its own stage label.

req_2_visual_ready_absolute_invariant.what: the VISUAL_READY invariant is ABSOLUTE: the state exists ONLY when geometry_state == visual_complete AND engineering_authority == ENGINEERING. The contradiction pairs (visual_complete + CONCEPTUAL, visual_complete + UNKNOWN, visual_complete + absent authority) fail closed to the NON-READY typed state GEOMETRY_READY_RENDER_BLOCKED with the new cause visual_authority_not_engineering (the cause vocabulary closes at ten) — the STATE itself is not ready, not merely the badge. 'Technology ready' remains produced exactly once behind the ENGINEERING guard (the second lock). The backend evaluator already refuses to announce visual readiness without the explicit ENGINEERING authority (the join is undecided for CONCEPTUAL/UNKNOWN) — the frontend is the layer where the pair is reachable, and it now refuses too.

req_3_persisted_identity_sovereignty.what: certified_canonical_glb certifies through PERSISTED documents only: DESIGN_LINEAGE.json's current-generation entry or ARTIFACT_IDENTITY.json (glb_path). The projection's carried geom.artifact_identity object is DIAGNOSTIC ONLY — it can never name the artifact, never supply a certifying SHA, never state the authority class, and never anchor the current generation (a forged geom object carrying a complete artifact identity certifies nothing when the persisted document is absent — attack 1). The current-generation anchor is persisted: the lineage current entry's own generation_id when recorded, else the persisted identity's generation_id; the projection's generation field is a contradiction diagnostic whose disagreement fails the certification CLOSED (never anchors). evaluate_geometry_contract mirrors the split: authority classes read the persisted identity, the PERSISTED BRIDGE_REPORT.json class fields, and the CAD ledger — the projection's carried class is removed from the authority sources; projection-carried SHAs remain contradiction-only checks (they can fail closed, never certify).

req_4_structural_glb_validation.what: OPTION (a) chosen: glb_format_check is upgraded from a header check to INDEPENDENT STRUCTURAL VALIDATION — the header (magic, version 2, declared length == file size) AND the chunk framing (every chunk's 8-byte sub-header fits; the first chunk is the JSON chunk; no chunk overruns the container; a BIN chunk is 4-byte aligned) AND the JSON structure (the JSON chunk parses as a JSON object carrying asset.version == "2.0"). A valid header over malformed internal structure (BIN first chunk, corrupt JSON, chunk overrun, missing asset version) FAILS. The contract wording is honest about scope: container-level structural validity (header + framing + JSON) — the semantic render verification remains the Visual Quality Gate's rendered measurement (Article LXXII); mesh/buffer semantics are not claimed.

req_5_adversarial_battery.what: tests/test_r451_c25_authority_boundary.py — the EIGHT directive attacks each proven to fail closed, plus the engineering positive control, the one-evaluator coupling, the watchdog dual-report proofs, and the byte-identical clean-state replay.

req_6_watchdog_dual_report.what: the watchdog report now carries the INDEPENDENT pair: observed_join_state (what THE evaluator observed, verbatim — an observation, never a verdict) and watchdog_verdict (the typed verdict: PASS / INTEGRITY_VIOLATION / JOIN_FAILURE_OBSERVED). Every violation carries its violation_class: RECORD_INVARIANT (R1-R9, or R10's announced-VISUAL_READY-vs-records coupling) vs JOIN_STATE_OBSERVATION (the evaluator's explicit non-ready states RELEASE_UNVERIFIED / RENDER_RECORD_MISSING / INVOCATION_MISSING — presentation-class findings). A presentation state is NEVER silently translated into a scientific rejection: the report's verdict vocabulary contains no scientific-rejection verdict at all (Art. LXI). The legacy verdict (PASS/FAIL) remains as the CLI exit-code projection, disclosed as such (Art. LXIV).
